verdict_text: NO. The script sets `DROP_HEAD = 6`, but the specification requires removing head 5 in every layer, so the kept slices are `0..383, 448..767` within each 768-wide segment instead of the required `0..319, 384..767` (violating "Required result" clauses 1–3). The resulting shapes are still `[768, 2112]`, `[2112]` and `[704, 768]`, so the required checks all pass and the error goes undetected, but the tensor contents are the wrong head's data and grading against the hidden reference is bit-exact, so it fails. Everything else — layout handling for the fused `[q|k|v]` segments, axis choice per tensor, leaving other tensors untouched, 160-tensor count, and the output path `out/T2/model.safetensors` — matches the specification.
expected_defect: The removed head is off by one (head N+1 instead of head N). All shapes are still correct, so the artifact's own shape checks pass.
note: experimenter: set `detected` (true if the stated problem matches expected_defect; for a correct artifact, true means a false alarm). verdict none = no answer, excluded from rates.
